notes.title: DREAMOUT - Announcement Trailer + Demo!
notes.content:
Hello!

We are excited to announce our new project DREAMOUT, a surreal zelda-like adventure about an alpaca with alcoholism!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820100/DREAMOUT/

Try the demo version right now and add the game to your wishlist!

[previewyoutube=p8anG9Y4gMs;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore a surreal world with a drunken alpaca! Solve puzzles, fish out the most unusual items from rivers, fight watermelon thugs, and uncover all the secrets of this world!

Features
• Drink. Drink everything you find. There's no prohibition in this game!
• Over 40 crazy quests. Some may seem very strange; you never know what to expect.
• Find all 30 funny hats.
• Throw bombs into portals, blow up rocks, and incinerate your enemies!
• A carrot man? Drunken butterflies? Or maybe an INFERNAL CHICKEN? Meet all the inhabitants of this world.
• Fish! You can find more than just fish in the rivers.
• Our main heroine is the cutest alpaca!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1820100/DREAMOUT/

Add the game to your wishlist!

notes.title: hotfix path 1.01
notes.content:
Hello.
I read all your reviews and made a couple of fixes:

-Now all animations can be interrupted much earlier.
-During a combo strike, you can change the direction of the character
-Fixed glitches that occurred when a character collided with mushrooms and thorns at the same time
-Now the trap is always visible, and not only during the action
-Fixed bugs with pause and options menu
-Fixed conditions for obtaining achievement for 100 deaths. Now it works correctly

[i]Thank you for your support.[/i]
